def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Fix body_mass_g: strip commas and convert to float
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
    
    # Set out-of-range body_mass_g to NaN (valid range 2500-6500)
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = float('nan')
    
    # Fix negative flipper_length_mm
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170, 'flipper_length_mm'] = float('nan')
    
    # Fix island label variants (extra spaces)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
